Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the Planner's analysis of the second WebSurfer result), the Planner incorrectly stated that the release date for the album "3.2.1." was July 23, **2018**. The WebSurfer's search results clearly and repeatedly displayed the year as **1998** (e.g., "released on July 23, 1998"). This hallucination of the year led the Planner to incorrectly conclude that Issa Album (2017) came out before 3.2.1. (2018), whereas in reality, 3.2.1. (1998) came out first.
